description: This file defines the GatewaySession class responsible for managing WebSocket-based communication with a gateway server. It handles connection establishment, message passing, reconnection strategies, and authentication flows in a Kotlin-based Android application. It includes data models, connection logic, message parsing, and event handling relevant to a gateway or remote server interface.

classes.name: GatewayClientInfo
classes.description: Data class representing client information sent during gateway connection.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Data class specifying options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, permissions, and client info.

classes.name: GatewayConnectErrorDetails
classes.description: Data class containing details about connection errors, including codes and retry suggestions.

classes.name: SelectedConnectAuth
classes.description: Data class encapsulating authentication token selection and source info during connection setup.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Primary class managing WebSocket connection, message handling, reconnection logic, and authentication with the gateway server.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to invoke a command on the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Class representing the result of an invocation, including success status, payload, or error.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Data class capturing error information returned from the gateway, including codes and messages.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Inner class managing individual WebSocket connection lifecycle, message exchange, and event handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts a connection to the gateway with specified parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates current connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Triggers reconnection logic, closing existing WebSocket if connected.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends a node event message with specified event name and payload JSON.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a request to the gateway with given method, parameters, and timeout.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability, updating cached URLs accordingly.
